article.story: Duke (4-2) at Virginia (4-3), Oct. 23 at 7 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Virginia by 2.5. Against the spread: Virginia 3-4, Duke 4-2. How to watch: ESPN Key stats Virginia Offense Overall: 362.9 yards per game (90th in FBS) Passing: 206.0 yards per game (96th) Rushing: 156.9 yards per game (68th) Scoring: 30.0 points per game (65th) Virginia Defense Overall: 326.6 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 173.9 yards per game (25th) Rushing: 152.7 yards per game (88th) Scoring: 19.7 points per game (38th) Duke Offense Overall: 442.7 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 233.2 yards per game (66th) Rushing: 209.5 yards per game (22nd) Scoring: 31.7 points per game (52nd) Duke Defense Overall: 292.7 yards per game (21st in FBS) Passing: 200.2 yards per game (58th) Rushing: 92.5 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 16.0 points per game (19th) Virginia ranks 120th in third down percentage, converting 33.0% of the time. Duke ranks 9th on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 29.2%. Virginia ranks 15th in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Duke is 123rd in the FBS averaging 73.8 penalty yards per game, compared to Virginia's 38th-ranked 49.3 per-game average. Virginia is 124th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 74.1% of trips. Duke's red zone defense ranks 42nd at 78.6%. Duke is 13th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 33:17. Team leaders Virginia Passing: Beau Pribula, 1,217 yards, 13 TDs, 1 INT, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jekail Middlebrook, 396 yards on 81 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Dashawn Martin, 231 yards on 15 catches, 5 TDs Duke Passing: Walker Eget, 1,229 yards, 8 TDs, 2 INTs, 62.8 completion percentage Rushing: Nate Sheppard, 820 yards on 138 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Sheppard, 259 yards on 28 catches, 4 TDs Last game Virginia fell 23-13 to SMU on Oct. 17. Pribula led Virginia with 137 yards on 13-of-22 passing (59.1%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards and one rushing touchdown. Middlebrook carried the ball 14 times for 59 yards, adding three receptions for 19 yards. Martin recorded 35 yards on two catches. Duke lost 24-20 to North Carolina on Oct. 17. Eget led Duke with 249 yards on 24-of-38 passing (63.2%) for one touchdown and one interception. Sheppard carried the ball 20 times for 77 yards, adding 11 receptions for 98 yards and one touchdown. Jared Richardson had three receptions for 55 yards. Next game Virginia plays at No. 17 Wake Forest on Oct. 31. Duke hosts Boston College on Oct. 31.
